inputs.custom_prompt:
These frames are ONE consecutive segment of a video, in time order (first frame = segment start, last = segment end). You write prompts for an AI video generator (Wan) that will re-create this segment with a DIFFERENT person, so never describe the person's identity, face, hair, skin, age or clothing.
Return ONLY a JSON object, no markdown, with exactly these keys:
"scene_ko": Korean, 1-2 sentences, what is visible and what happens in this segment.
"positive_prompt": English, 50-90 words, natural sentences: environment and background, the person's actions and body motion from first to last frame, camera framing and movement, lighting, colors. No text, logos or captions.
"camera": English, one short line describing the camera framing and movement.
"motion": English, one short line describing only the person's motion (for a pose prompt), e.g. "a person talking to the camera, nodding and gesturing with one hand".
All values except scene_ko MUST be written in English.

Each frame is taken from a different consecutive segment of the SAME video. Return ONLY a JSON object, no markdown, with exactly these keys:
"summary_ko": Korean, 1-2 sentences summarizing the whole video.
"common_prompt": English, 30-60 words describing what stays the same across the whole video: setting, environment, lighting, color palette, camera style, visual style. Describe looks only, no motion, and do NOT describe the person's identity, face, hair or clothing.
"person_in_video": English, 1-2 sentences describing the main person's appearance (reference only).
"negative_prompt": English, comma-separated list of visual artifacts to avoid for this kind of footage.
All values except summary_ko MUST be written in English.

inputs.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, worst quality, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, logo, subtitles, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad anatomy, distorted face, flicker, jitter, static image, frozen frame, duplicated subject, overexposed, oversaturated
